03-28-1242 is March 28, 1242.  
20 weeks = 140 days.  
Add 1 more day → 141 days before March 28, 1242.  

March has 31 days.  
March 28 - 141 days:  
Step back 28 days to March 1 → 28 days subtracted, 113 days left.  
February 1242 is a leap year? 1242 is not divisible by 4 → 28 days in Feb.  
Back through Feb (28 days) → 85 days left.  
Back through Jan (31 days) → 54 days left.  
Back through Dec 1241 (31 days) → 23 days left.  
Back through Nov 1241 (30 days) → goes negative, so stop at Nov.  
Dec 1, 1241 minus 23 days = Nov 8, 1241.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1241-11-08
